references.text: Kings and rulers are urged to learn and serve the Lord with reverence
All people, high and low, are urged to listen to wisdom
An appeal to hear, using similar language about listening to the Lord's word
Moses' song has a similar opening with an appeal to heaven and earth to listen, and praise of the Lord's name
An appeal to sing to God and praise his name
The song of Moses and Israel to the Lord after deliverance, with similar praise to the God of Israel
Praise of the Lord, the Most High, and a song of praise to his name
I will sing a song of praise to your name, O Most High
